title: Ecological workflows with Sharkipedia data
text: Chondrichthyans among threatened vertebrate lineages. Comparative traits (maturity, growth, fecundity) standardized abundance trends currency : Extinction-risk assessment (IUCN Red List criteria tied population reduction), Data-limited fisheries methods (life-history priors rr, FMSYF_{MSY}, generation time), Macroecology (allometric life-history invariants across species). Sharkipedia centralizes measurements traceable references. sharkipediaR lets treat Sharkipedia like data API R — filter, summarize, plot familiar %>% pipes interactive plotly charts vignette. Throughout vignette use example_carcharhinus() (blacknose shark, Carcharhinus acronotus), data-rich coastal species traits Northwest Atlantic trends. Live extraction identical — swap sp_traits() / sp_trends() online.

Unit: ", unit ) )) + geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) + geom_point(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.7) + labs( title = "Multiple abundance trends for one species", subtitle = "Interactive: zoom, pan, and hover for metadata", x = "Year", y = "Value (units vary by series)", colour = "Location", caption = meta$source_url[[1]] ) + theme_shark() + theme(legend.position = "bottom") as_interactive(p_facet) sp_trends("Carcharhinus acronotus")
